body:
The Tab indent regression https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/120103 definitely needs to be fixed, but this PR causes inconsistencies in the calculation of vertical height during line breaks by making it dependent on the presence of characters on the line.

---

Before (RC1):

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/8355a913-0757-44f0-91e3-fe538c9cb33f

The height of all line breaks is calculated, consistent.

e.g.

```


```
^ height is x3

```
a

```
^ height is x2

```
a


```
^ height is x3

---

After (this PR):

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c0da60a9-9033-4d40-9b5f-945935257b50

When everything is just line breaks, the height is calculated; however, if there are characters, in cases with two or more line breaks, the height is calculated for only one, inconsistent.

e.g.

```


```
^ height is x2

```
a

```
^ height is x1

```
a


```
^ height is x2

---

[mlttest.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28772301/mlttest.zip)

When there are no characters and only a line break, the vertical height is calculated. If we take this as the base, the current behavior of the RC is more consistent.

If we take this PR as the base, I think you need to make the vertical height for a string with only a line break like:

```


```

should become x0 or x1.

However, personally, I consider the current state of the RC to be more desirable. This is because there are many cases where it looks better to calculate the vertical height of the dialog first before displaying the first character of the line. Ideally, we should make this as options like `ignore_line_break_on_end_of_text` and `merge_consecutive_empty_lines` allow users to choose between "always calculate" / "never calculate" the height of lines containing only line breaks in end of the text, but adding that option should probably be done in version 4.8.

|text|ignore_line_break_on_end_of_text|merge_consecutive_empty_lines|result height|
|--|--|--|--|
|\n\n\n|false|false|x4|
|\n\n\n|false|true|x1|
|\n\n\n|true|false|x3|
|\n\n\n|true|true|x0|
|A\n\n|false|false|x3|
|A\n\n|false|true|x2|
|A\n\n|true|false|x2|
|A\n\n|true|true|x1|
|A\n\nA|false|false|x4|
|A\n\nA|false|true|x3|
|A\n\nA|true|false|x4|
|A\n\nA|true|true|x3|

In any case, I think we should ensure consistency in one of these behaviors here and fix the regression related to tab indent. And I think the right approach is to set that as the default value for the two options mentioned above in version 4.8.

Given the current state of this PR, I assume the default behavior for maintaining the current state is to set `ignore_line_break_on_end_of_text` to `true` and `merge_consecutive_empty_lines` to `false`. However, in that case, the behavior of ignoring the final line break in text consisting solely of line break is missing, so this PR should fix that behavior.

So eventually,

```


```

should become x1, not x2.
